name: Apex
_about: Apex: a racing cluster (Nov 13 2026): a rev band across the top (up to 1500, level to 6500, down to 8000) of 32 blocks, filled in a continuous line as the revs rise (white, orange from 6000, red from 6500); the speed in the middle, the gear and P R N D M right of it, boost and braking bars left of it, coolant and fuel / range along the bottom; a thin white tray line. Made by cluster-design/apex/build.html. Widget reference: shared/hud.js header.
